evidence.quote: Duration of the program: This is a 3.5-year program consisting of 7 academic semesters
Duration of the course / programme: 7 semesters
All courses are taught in English; therefore, a B2 level English proficiency is required.

notes: The tuition quote '7,000 USD/Year' is stated on the programme page and is the self-financed fee; the general fee table lists 'Chemical Engineering *' under 7,500 USD/year for 2026/27, while the programme page says 7,000 USD/year, so the programme page figure was used. Application deadline 15 June is given without a year on the programme page; the application page gives 15 June 2026 for the September 2026/2027 intake, so it was recorded as a recurring deadline (15 June). The programme page names mathematics and chemistry entrance exams, but 'mathematics' and 'chemistry' are not in the allowed subject list; recorded as a manual check. No document list is given on the programme page itself; documents were taken from the central application page.

note.fr: L'admission repose sur un certificat de fin d'études secondaires et des examens d'entrée en mathématiques et en chimie : vérifiez les modalités et le seuil (75 % pour l'admission, 60-75 % pour une année préparatoire).
note.en: Admission is based on a high school certificate and entrance exams in Mathematics and Chemistry: check the format and the threshold (75% for admission, 60-75% for a foundation year).

evidence.quote: Admission requires a high school certificate and passing entrance exams in Mathematics and Chemistry.
Results about 75% and over mean admission to the selected programme, results between 60%-75% -admission to a preparatory (foundation year) programme.

note.en: The application fee (150 USD) and entrance exam fee (350 USD) must be paid by bank transfer and are non-refundable.
